brief: Prioritise this ageing unit for pre-event attention because units of advanced age with a history of high loading have a reduced margin against mechanical failure under the thermal cycling of a multi-day heat event [MG-023]. Where this unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure [MG-023]. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value and the period, and restore the full rating only when the underlying condition has been corrected and verified [MG-021].
